packet_dag.terminal_condition: The One Time AI Studio operator can use a scoped sidekick for prompt/image correction, mock OpenArt handoff, and Studio-only repair requests while unrelated website/admin/CLI/external actions are blocked; live OpenArt OAuth remains a precise blocker.

title: One Time AI Studio Sidekick, OpenArt MCP Boundary, And Studio-Only Repair Lane

reasons: The operator approved a goal-mode build for a scoped One Time AI Studio sidekick.
The request spans role/RBAC, assistant workflow, prompt/image analysis, OpenArt MCP integration, Studio UI/functionality repair, and a constrained CLI/Codex lane.
Live OpenArt signup/OAuth is explicitly deferred, so implementation must separate mock/no-live BNA work from external provider setup.
likely_external_provider_blockers: OpenArt account, workspace, OAuth and MCP runtime are not yet connected.
Exact hosted multimodal prompt/vision model is not selected.
No live render, OpenArt generation, upload, send, payment, access grant, deploy, DNS, or external account mutation is approved by this packet.
ramble_router.next_exact_packet: Generate the Studio sidekick surface map/current-state audit, then implement the role/policy and no-live adapter batches.

operator_intent_summary: Create a narrowly scoped One Time AI Studio operator experience where the assigned user can use natural language and image uploads to improve OpenArt-ready prompts, store patches, manage characters, run or request Studio-only repairs, and eventually connect through OpenArt MCP after Shloimie signs up.
raw_quotes: only scope for Corrections regarding this prompt
focus and generating The Prompt storing The Prompt but also analyzing the images
he should have the ability to automatically just speak to the CLI only in regards to his specific scopes
anything that has to do with the layout or functionality of the studio
build everything, everything, everything, and then I'll sign up when you're done building

decisions_captured.decision: Build mock/no-live OpenArt adapter and BNA workflow now; live OpenArt OAuth/MCP remains blocked until Shloimie signs up/connects the account.
Studio operator may use only a mediated Studio-scoped CLI/Codex repair lane for Studio layout/functionality, with raw shell, deploy, secrets, and non-Studio website changes denied.
Exact hosted multimodal model is not selected; use an adapter boundary and tests rather than hard-coding an unavailable model.

out_of_scope: No live OpenArt OAuth or MCP call until Shloimie signs up/connects the account.

No broad website, landing-page, CRM, payments, contacts, settings, integrations, admin, secret, DNS, deployment, external send, external upload, payment, access-grant, GHL runtime, LeadConnector runtime, or cross-workspace mutation.
No raw arbitrary shell from the Studio operator.
No promotion of this operator's Studio changes to other workspaces until Shloimie explicitly approves a later packet.
No final claim of app-visible Done without deploy/live smoke, or a precise deployment blocker.
affected_surfaces: Studio character and image critique records
Operations task view filtered to assigned Studio tasks

current_state.summary: Studio already has scoped projects, prompt compile, correction preview/apply, mock render, usage, handoff, character library, action registry rows, and route registry rows. The new gap is a role-scoped Studio sidekick that can reason over image uploads, create official prompt patches, track OpenArt-ready assets, expose a mock/live MCP boundary, and safely route only Studio layout/functionality repair requests to Codex.
inspection_targets: Studio API route allowlist and workspace scope
route/action registry entries for Studio and assistants
known_blockers: Live OpenArt account/OAuth/MCP is unavailable until Shloimie signs up.
Exact hosted multimodal GPT-style model is not selected.
Current web/provider assistant policy blocks broad Codex/CLI; a new mediated Studio-only repair lane must be implemented before any user-facing CLI-like action is exposed.

expanded_phrases.super professional: The Studio operator sees a compact production-grade workspace for assigned projects, prompt/image sidekick, characters, patches, OpenArt readiness, jobs, and tasks without admin clutter.
expanded_phrases.perfect: Every sidekick action has a scoped behavior, preview/diff, reversible write or named blocker, tests, registry coverage, and evidence.
expanded_phrases.work until it's done: Requirements stay open until implemented, verified, deployed/live-smoked if app-visible, or precisely blocked.
expanded_phrases.build everything: Build all BNA-side local-safe components now; live OpenArt OAuth/MCP remains a separated blocker.
expanded_phrases.functionality of the studio: Studio-only repair lane may target prompt patching, Studio UI layout, Studio routes, Studio tests, and Studio adapter/config files only.
expanded_phrases.configured: OpenArt and hosted vision model setup must show an explicit blocked/configured status: mock/no-live BNA adapter works locally; live OAuth/model credentials remain blocked until approved account setup.

product_quality_expansion.compiled_requirement: Add a One Time AI Studio operator role and sidekick that supports prompt/image critique, prompt patch storage, mock OpenArt MCP workflow, assigned Studio tasks, and a strictly allowlisted Studio-only repair lane.

requirements.statement: Define and enforce the one_time_ai_studio_operator role.
requirements.expected_result: The user can reach only One Time Studio, assigned Studio tasks, and allowed Studio sidekick actions.
acceptance_criteria: Role policy allows Studio and tasks views only for rabbi_sheller_provider / one_time_mishnah_class.
Role policy denies contacts, payments, settings, integrations, admin, cross-workspace data, sends, secrets, deploys, and broad website changes.

requirements.statement: Implement the Studio sidekick prompt/image workflow.
requirements.expected_result: The operator can upload or reference a render image, describe the problem, receive a visual critique and OpenArt-ready prompt patch, preview the diff, and save/apply the patch to the scoped Studio project.
acceptance_criteria: Image analysis has a mock/adapter path for tests and a no-secret model boundary.
Prompt patch suggestions target scene, character, style, or project scope.
Patch preview and apply remain reversible and scoped to the selected Studio project.

requirements.statement: Create an OpenArt MCP adapter boundary with mock/no-live mode.
requirements.expected_result: BNA can build and test OpenArt-ready prompt/project/reference/result flows before live OAuth.
acceptance_criteria: Adapter exposes capability/status, prompt export, reference upload planning, result import planning, and credit/account blockers.
Live calls are disabled until account/OAuth is configured.
No OpenArt credentials or account data are required for local tests.

requirements.statement: Implement a mediated Studio-only Codex/CLI repair lane.
requirements.expected_result: The operator can report Studio bugs and request Studio layout/functionality repairs, but only an allowlisted Studio repair job can be created or run.
acceptance_criteria: Allowed target categories include Studio layout, Studio prompt patching, Studio sidekick, Studio adapter mock/config, and focused Studio tests.
Denied categories include arbitrary shell, deploy, secrets, payments, sends, contacts, settings, integrations, non-Studio website changes, and cross-workspace promotion.
Tests prove malicious or off-scope requests are blocked.

criteria: Raw intake and goal-mode register exist.
Workspace/project and view classes are exact.
Live OpenArt OAuth/MCP is separated as an external blocker.
Implementation scope is limited to Studio/operator role, sidekick, mock adapter, task filtering, and Studio-only repair policy.
Route/action registries and focused tests are named.
Deployment/live smoke remains required before app-visible terminal Done.
